tagline_zh: 由 AI 為你策展，專屬早晨讀物

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 取得 FedRAMP Moderate 授權
articles.title_en: OpenAI Achieves FedRAMP Moderate Authorization
articles.lede_zh: OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Enterprise 和 API 已獲得 FedRAMP Moderate 授權,可供美國聯邦機構安全部署 AI。這項認證確保符合政府級資安標準,讓公部門能夠導入先進 AI 工具處理敏感但非機密資料。對台灣而言,可參考此合規架構規劃政府 AI 採購。
articles.lede_en: OpenAI has achieved FedRAMP Moderate authorization for ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API, enabling U.S. federal agencies to securely adopt AI. This certification ensures compliance with government-grade security standards, allowing public sector deployment for sensitive but unclassified data. Taiwan can reference this compliance framework for government AI procurement.
bullets_zh: ChatGPT Enterprise 與 API 皆通過 FedRAMP Moderate 認證
符合美國聯邦政府對敏感資料處理的資安要求
為公部門 AI 導入提供合規範本與安全架構參考
bullets_en: Both ChatGPT Enterprise and API achieve FedRAMP Moderate certification
Meets U.S. federal security requirements for sensitive data handling
Provides compliance template and security architecture for public sector AI adoption

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 與微軟合作協議進入新階段
articles.title_en: OpenAI and Microsoft Enter New Partnership Phase
articles.lede_zh: OpenAI 與微軟宣布修訂合作協議,簡化夥伴關係並增加長期明確性,支持大規模 AI 創新。新協議預計將給予雙方更大彈性,同時維持技術與基礎設施的深度整合。此調整反映 AI 產業從研發走向規模化商用的策略轉變。
articles.lede_en: OpenAI and Microsoft announce an amended partnership agreement that simplifies collaboration, adds long-term clarity, and supports AI innovation at scale. The new agreement provides both parties greater flexibility while maintaining deep technical and infrastructure integration. This shift reflects the AI industry's strategic transition from R&D to scaled commercialization.
bullets_zh: 簡化合作框架並明確長期權責分工
雙方保有更大營運彈性與獨立性
反映 AI 產業從研發階段邁向商業規模化
bullets_en: Simplifies collaboration framework with clearer long-term responsibilities
Both parties gain greater operational flexibility and independence
Reflects AI industry shift from research phase to commercial scale

articles.title_zh: Symphony:開源 Codex 編排規範
articles.title_en: Symphony: Open-Source Spec for Codex Orchestration
articles.lede_zh: Symphony 是一套開源規範,將問題追蹤器轉化為常駐 agent 系統,用於 Codex 編排。它能自動化工程任務、減少工程師的情境切換,並提升團隊產出。開發團隊可透過整合現有工具快速部署 AI 輔助工作流程。
articles.lede_en: Symphony is an open-source specification that transforms issue trackers into always-on agent systems for Codex orchestration. It automates engineering tasks, reduces context switching, and boosts team output. Development teams can rapidly deploy AI-assisted workflows by integrating existing tools.
bullets_zh: 將問題追蹤器升級為 AI agent 編排平台
自動化重複性工程任務,降低情境切換成本
開源規範可整合現有開發工具與流程
bullets_en: Upgrades issue trackers into AI agent orchestration platforms
Automates repetitive engineering tasks and reduces context switching
Open-source spec integrates with existing development tools and workflows

articles.title_zh: Choco 以 AI agent 自動化食品配送
articles.title_en: Choco Automates Food Distribution with AI Agents
articles.lede_zh: 食品配送平台 Choco 運用 OpenAI API 簡化配送流程、提升生產力並解鎖成長潛能。AI agent 處理訂單管理、供應鏈協調與客戶溝通等重複性任務,讓團隊專注於策略決策。此案例展示垂直領域 AI 應用如何創造實質商業價值。
articles.lede_en: Food distribution platform Choco leverages OpenAI APIs to streamline distribution, boost productivity, and unlock growth. AI agents handle repetitive tasks like order management, supply chain coordination, and customer communication, allowing teams to focus on strategic decisions. This case demonstrates how vertical AI applications create tangible business value.
bullets_zh: AI 處理訂單、供應鏈與客戶溝通等重複任務
團隊得以專注於高價值策略性工作
垂直產業 AI 應用的實際商業價值案例
bullets_en: AI handles repetitive tasks in ordering, supply chain, and customer communication
Teams focus on high-value strategic work
Real-world case of vertical industry AI delivering business value

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 執行長分享五大核心原則
articles.title_en: OpenAI CEO Shares Five Core Principles
articles.lede_zh: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 闡述公司使命與五項指導原則,目標是確保 AGI 惠及全人類。這些原則涵蓋安全研發、廣泛受益、長期導向等面向,為 AI 研發組織提供治理與價值觀參考框架。
articles.lede_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman outlines the company's mission and five guiding principles aimed at ensuring AGI benefits all of humanity. These principles cover safe development, broad benefit distribution, and long-term orientation, providing a governance and values framework for AI research organizations.
bullets_zh: 確保 AGI 發展以人類整體福祉為核心
涵蓋安全、公益、長期視野等治理面向
為 AI 組織提供價值觀與治理架構參考
bullets_en: Ensures AGI development centers on overall human well-being
Covers safety, public benefit, and long-term governance dimensions
Provides values and governance framework reference for AI organizations

articles.title_zh: Vercel Hobby 方案部署保留期限縮為 30 天
articles.title_en: Vercel Hobby Plans Default to 30-Day Deployment Retention
articles.lede_zh: 自 4 月 29 日起,Vercel Hobby 方案部署保留期上限為 30 天,超出範圍的部署將自動移除,但最近 10 個生產部署與別名部署不受影響。Pro 和 Enterprise 方案不受此變更影響。開發者需評估專案需求,決定是否升級方案。
articles.lede_en: Starting April 29th, Vercel Hobby plans cap deployment retention at 30 days, with automatic removal of deployments outside this window, excluding the 10 most recent production deployments and aliased ones. Pro and Enterprise plans remain unaffected. Developers should assess project needs to determine if plan upgrades are necessary.
bullets_zh: Hobby 方案部署保留期上限 30 天,自動清理舊部署
最近 10 個生產部署與別名部署不受影響
Pro 與 Enterprise 方案維持原保留政策
bullets_en: Hobby plans cap retention at 30 days with automatic cleanup
10 most recent production and aliased deployments remain preserved
Pro and Enterprise plans maintain original retention policies

articles.title_zh: 多保真度數位雙生結合 FMEA 的航空故障診斷
articles.title_en: Multi-Fidelity Digital Twin with FMEA for Aircraft Fault Diagnosis
articles.lede_zh: 研究提出結合多保真度數位雙生與 FMEA 知識增強的通用航空故障診斷框架。整合高保真飛行動力學模擬、FMEA 驅動故障注入、多保真度殘差特徵萃取與 LLM 增強可解釋報告生成,解決實際故障資料稀缺問題。適用於航太、自駕車等高安全需求領域。
articles.lede_en: Research proposes a general aviation fault diagnosis framework combining multi-fidelity digital twin and FMEA knowledge enhancement. It integrates high-fidelity flight dynamics simulation, FMEA-driven fault injection, multi-fidelity residual feature extraction, and LLM-enhanced interpretable reporting, addressing scarce real fault data. Applicable to high-safety domains like aerospace and autonomous vehicles.
bullets_zh: 數位雙生模擬產生訓練資料,克服實際故障樣本不足
FMEA 知識注入提升故障識別準確度
LLM 生成可解釋診斷報告,增進人機協作
bullets_en: Digital twin simulation generates training data, overcoming real fault sample scarcity
FMEA knowledge injection improves fault identification accuracy
LLM generates interpretable diagnostic reports for better human-machine collaboration

articles.title_zh: PExA:平行探索 agent 解決複雜 Text-to-SQL
articles.title_en: PExA: Parallel Exploration Agent for Complex Text-to-SQL
articles.lede_zh: PExA 以軟體測試覆蓋率概念重構 Text-to-SQL 生成,將複雜查詢拆解為多個簡單原子 SQL 測試案例並行執行。透過迭代測試案例覆蓋率,在收集足夠資訊後才生成最終 SQL,平衡延遲與效能。適用於企業 BI 工具與資料分析平台。
articles.lede_en: PExA reframes Text-to-SQL generation using software test coverage concepts, decomposing complex queries into simpler atomic SQL test cases executed in parallel. By iterating on test case coverage, it generates final SQL only after gathering sufficient information, balancing latency and performance. Applicable to enterprise BI tools and data analytics platforms.
bullets_zh: 將複雜 SQL 查詢拆解為並行測試案例
迭代測試覆蓋率,平衡效能與延遲
適合企業 BI 與資料分析場景
bullets_en: Decomposes complex SQL queries into parallel test cases
Iterates test coverage to balance performance and latency
Suitable for enterprise BI and data analytics scenarios

articles.title_zh: 冪次定律分布助力組合推理能力
articles.title_en: Power-Law Distribution Enables Compositional Reasoning
articles.lede_zh: 研究發現訓練資料的冪次定律分布比均勻分布更能提升模型的組合推理能力。在狀態追蹤、多步驟算術等任務中,冪次分布訓練持續優於均勻分布。這挑戰了「資料重採樣應趨向均勻」的直覺,為資料策展與課程學習提供新方向。
articles.lede_en: Research reveals that power-law distribution in training data consistently outperforms uniform distribution for compositional reasoning. Across tasks like state tracking and multi-step arithmetic, power-law training proves superior. This challenges the intuition that data resampling should trend toward uniformity, offering new directions for data curation and curriculum learning.
bullets_zh: 冪次分布訓練在組合推理任務上優於均勻分布
挑戰資料重採樣應均勻化的傳統假設
為訓練資料策展與課程設計提供新思路
bullets_en: Power-law training outperforms uniform distribution in compositional reasoning
Challenges traditional assumption that data resampling should be uniform
Provides new insights for training data curation and curriculum design

articles.title_zh: 偏好論證框架的逆解問題研究
articles.title_en: Inverse Problem for Preference-Based Argumentation Frameworks
articles.lede_zh: 研究探討偏好論證框架(PAF)的逆問題:給定論證圖、標記與語義,是否存在偏好關係能產生期望標記。此問題對解釋 AI 推論、驗證論證系統一致性具重要意義。可應用於可解釋 AI、多 agent 系統與決策支援工具。
articles.lede_en: Research explores the inverse problem for preference-based argumentation frameworks (PAFs): given an argumentation graph, labelling, and semantics, does a preference relation exist to yield the desired labelling? This is crucial for explaining AI reasoning and verifying argumentation system consistency. Applicable to explainable AI, multi-agent systems, and decision support tools.
bullets_zh: 探討從標記反推偏好關係的可行性
對論證系統一致性驗證與解釋性提升有重要價值
可應用於可解釋 AI 與多 agent 決策系統
bullets_en: Explores feasibility of inferring preference relations from labellings
Valuable for argumentation system consistency verification and explainability
Applicable to explainable AI and multi-agent decision systems

articles.title_zh: Anthropic Mythos 對資安的深遠影響
articles.title_en: What Anthropic's Mythos Means for Cybersecurity
articles.lede_zh: Anthropic 的 Claude Mythos Preview 能自主發現並武器化軟體漏洞,將其轉化為可執行攻擊程式碼,無需專家指導。這些漏洞存在於作業系統與網路基礎設施等關鍵軟體中,將對日常設備與服務安全產生重大影響。因此 Anthropic 不對外公開發布此模型。
articles.lede_en: Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview autonomously finds and weaponizes software vulnerabilities, turning them into working exploits without expert guidance. These vulnerabilities exist in critical software like operating systems and internet infrastructure, posing major security implications for everyday devices and services. Consequently, Anthropic is not releasing the model publicly.
bullets_zh: 模型可自主發現並利用作業系統與基礎設施漏洞
無需人類專家指導即可產生可執行攻擊程式碼
因安全風險考量不對外公開發布
bullets_en: Model autonomously discovers and exploits OS and infrastructure vulnerabilities
Generates executable exploit code without human expert guidance
Not publicly released due to security risk considerations

articles.title_zh: 中世紀加密信件成功解密
articles.title_en: Medieval Encrypted Letter Decoded
articles.lede_zh: 一封西班牙外交官寄出的中世紀加密信件成功解密。該信件自 1860 年重新發現以來,研究人員持續嘗試破解。此案例展示歷史密碼學研究的持續價值與現代解密技術的進展。
articles.lede_en: A medieval encrypted letter sent by a Spanish diplomat has been successfully decoded. Researchers have been working on it since its rediscovery in 1860. This case demonstrates the enduring value of historical cryptography research and advances in modern decryption techniques.
bullets_zh: 西班牙外交官寄出的中世紀加密信件
自 1860 年重新發現後歷經多年破解
展示歷史密碼學與現代解密技術結合
bullets_en: Medieval encrypted letter sent by Spanish diplomat
Decryption efforts ongoing since 1860 rediscovery
Demonstrates combination of historical cryptography and modern decryption

articles.title_zh: eVTOL 馬達與電動車馬達的差異
articles.title_en: What Makes eVTOL Motors Different from EV Motors
articles.lede_zh: eVTOL 飛行器與電動車雖都採用電動馬達,但在元件成本、重量與冗餘設計上有關鍵差異。前 Tesla 電池工程資深總監、現任 Joby Aviation 動力系統負責人 Jon Wagner 說明,航空應用對輕量化、可靠性與故障容錯的要求遠高於車輛。
articles.lede_en: While eVTOL aircraft and electric vehicles both use electric motors, they differ critically in component cost, mass, and redundancy design. Jon Wagner, former Tesla senior director of battery engineering and current Joby Aviation powertrain lead, explains that aviation applications demand far higher lightweighting, reliability, and fault tolerance than vehicles.
bullets_zh: 航空馬達對輕量化與可靠性要求遠高於車用
冗餘設計確保單點故障不影響飛行安全
元件成本結構與供應鏈策略顯著不同
bullets_en: Aviation motors demand much higher lightweighting and reliability than automotive
Redundancy design ensures single-point failures don't compromise flight safety
Component cost structure and supply chain strategy differ significantly

articles.title_zh: 紐約大學以跨域碰撞重塑健康研究
articles.title_en: How NYU Is Remaking Health Research with Engineered Collisions
articles.lede_zh: 紐約大學工程健康研究所打破傳統學科界線,以疾病狀態而非學科為組織核心。不同於生物系做生物、工程系做工程的傳統模式,該所促進跨領域專家協作解決特定健康問題。此模式為學術研究組織提供新範式。
articles.lede_en: NYU's Institute for Engineering Health breaks traditional disciplinary boundaries, organizing around disease states rather than academic departments. Unlike the traditional model where biology departments do biology and engineering departments do engineering, the institute fosters cross-disciplinary collaboration to solve specific health problems. This model offers a new paradigm for academic research organization.
bullets_zh: 以疾病狀態為核心,打破傳統學科分界
促進生物、工程、醫學等領域專家深度協作
為學術研究組織提供新型跨域合作範式
bullets_en: Organizes around disease states, breaking traditional disciplinary boundaries
Fosters deep collaboration among biology, engineering, and medical experts
Offers new paradigm for cross-disciplinary academic research organization

articles.title_zh: 現代電力系統建模與模擬方法
articles.title_en: Modeling and Simulation Approaches for Modern Power Systems
articles.lede_zh: 此線上研討會涵蓋跨時間尺度的電力系統建模與模擬,從準靜態 8760 分析到 EMT 研究、故障分類與逆變器為基礎資源併網。參加者將學習程式化網路建構、多保真度建模與從準靜態相量到非線性電磁暫態的分析方法。
articles.lede_en: This webinar covers power system modeling and simulation across multiple timescales, from quasi-static 8760 analysis to EMT studies, fault classification, and inverter-based resource grid integration. Attendees will learn programmatic network construction, multi-fidelity modeling, and analysis methods from quasi-static phasor to nonlinear electromagnetic transient.
bullets_zh: 涵蓋多時間尺度電力系統模擬方法
從準靜態分析到電磁暫態研究的完整流程
逆變器為基礎資源併網模擬技術
bullets_en: Covers multi-timescale power system simulation methods
Complete workflow from quasi-static analysis to electromagnetic transient studies
Inverter-based resource grid integration simulation techniques

articles.title_zh: Claude Mythos Preview 要求新的程式碼安全方法
articles.title_en: Claude Mythos Preview Requires New Ways to Keep Code Secure
articles.lede_zh: 惡意行為者正利用生成式 AI 執行網路攻擊,包括 AI 生成的深偽詐騙、AI 輔助惡意軟體開發、chatbot 釣魚與 AI agent 入侵開源程式碼庫。Anthropic 的 Claude Mythos Preview 已識別出數千個高嚴重性漏洞,這些 AI 驅動威脅正持續上升。
articles.lede_en: Malicious actors are exploiting generative AI for cyberattacks, including AI-generated deepfake scams, AI-assisted malware development, chatbot phishing, and AI agent hacking of open-source repositories. Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview has identified thousands of high-severity vulnerabilities, and these AI-driven threats are rising.
bullets_zh: AI 被用於深偽詐騙、惡意軟體開發與釣魚攻擊
Claude Mythos Preview 已發現數千個高嚴重性漏洞
AI 驅動的資安威脅持續升高,需要新防禦策略
bullets_en: AI used for deepfake scams, malware development, and phishing attacks
Claude Mythos Preview has identified thousands of high-severity vulnerabilities
AI-driven security threats rising, requiring new defense strategies

articles.title_zh: GitHub 可用性改善進度更新
articles.title_en: An Update on GitHub Availability
articles.lede_zh: GitHub 分享已完成與正在進行的可用性與可靠性改善措施。更新包含基礎設施升級、監控強化與事件回應流程優化,目標是降低服務中斷頻率與影響範圍。開發團隊可參考其透明度實踐與技術債務管理策略。
articles.lede_en: GitHub shares completed and ongoing improvements to availability and reliability. Updates include infrastructure upgrades, enhanced monitoring, and optimized incident response processes, aiming to reduce service disruption frequency and impact scope. Development teams can reference its transparency practices and technical debt management strategies.
bullets_zh: 基礎設施升級與監控系統強化
事件回應流程持續優化
透明溝通服務改善進度與技術債務管理
bullets_en: Infrastructure upgrades and monitoring system enhancements
Ongoing incident response process optimization
Transparent communication of service improvements and technical debt management

articles.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 轉為用量計費模式
articles.title_en: GitHub Copilot Moves to Usage-Based Billing
articles.lede_zh: 自 6 月 1 日起,GitHub Copilot 使用量將消耗 GitHub AI Credits。此轉變從固定月費改為依實際使用量計費,讓組織更精準控制 AI 輔助開發成本。開發團隊需評估使用模式,規劃 credit 預算與成本監控機制。
articles.lede_en: Starting June 1, GitHub Copilot usage will consume GitHub AI Credits. This shift moves from fixed monthly fees to usage-based billing, enabling organizations to more precisely control AI-assisted development costs. Development teams should assess usage patterns and plan credit budgets and cost monitoring mechanisms.
bullets_zh: 從固定月費轉為用量計費模式
組織可更精準控制 AI 輔助開發成本
需評估使用模式並規劃 credit 預算
bullets_en: Shifts from fixed monthly fees to usage-based billing
Organizations gain more precise control over AI-assisted development costs
Requires usage pattern assessment and credit budget planning

articles.title_zh: Spotify 股價下跌,投資人憂心漲價影響
articles.title_en: Spotify Shares Slump as Investors Fret About Price Rises
articles.lede_zh: Spotify 宣布提高訂閱價格後股價下跌,市場密切關注用戶對漲價的反應。投資人擔心價格上漲可能導致訂閱戶流失,影響營收成長。此案例反映訂閱制商業模式在價格彈性與用戶留存之間的平衡挑戰。
articles.lede_en: Spotify shares slumped after announcing subscription price increases, with markets closely watching subscriber response. Investors worry price hikes may lead to subscriber churn, impacting revenue growth. This case reflects the balance challenge between price elasticity and user retention in subscription business models.
bullets_zh: 訂閱價格上漲引發投資人對用戶流失的擔憂
市場密切關注漲價對訂閱戶數的影響
反映訂閱制商業模式的價格策略挑戰
bullets_en: Subscription price increases trigger investor concerns about user churn
Market closely monitors impact of price hikes on subscriber counts
Reflects pricing strategy challenges in subscription business models

articles.title_zh: 企業實施手機禁令引發員工複雜反應
articles.title_en: Employees Face Phone Bans at Work with Mixed Feelings
articles.lede_zh: 部分企業要求員工將手機鎖入收納袋,以消除分心並保護資料。員工對此反應複雜,既感到有趣又覺得尷尬。此趨勢反映企業在提升專注力與資安防護之間的管理創新,但也引發隱私與信任議題。
articles.lede_en: Some companies require staff to lock devices in pouches to remove distractions and protect data. Employees respond with mixed feelings—half-amused, half-ashamed. This trend reflects management innovation balancing focus enhancement and data security, but also raises privacy and trust issues.
bullets_zh: 企業以手機鎖袋消除分心並保護敏感資料
員工反應複雜,既好奇又感到不自在
引發職場專注力、資安與隱私信任的討論
bullets_en: Companies use phone pouches to eliminate distractions and protect sensitive data
Employee reactions mixed—curious yet uncomfortable
Sparks discussions on workplace focus, data security, and privacy trust
